friendai.freetime.storage_full: The storage is full; we need more chests.
friendai.freetime.stage_reached: I've moved up to the %s stage.
friendai.freetime.stalled: I want to get on with something, but nothing can start right now; I'll try again shortly.
friendai.fire.self: I'm on fire — putting myself out.
friendai.fire.owner: You're on fire — I'll put it out.
friendai.fire.owner_out_of_reach: You're on fire, but I can't reach you.

friendai.command.reloaded_with_fixes: Config reloaded; %s invalid values were corrected (see the log).
friendai.memory.corrupt: Your companion's memory file was damaged and has been reset. The old file was kept as a .bak copy.
friendai.command.untrust.unknown: %s is not in your trusted list.
friendai.trust.button.confirm.hover: Click to confirm. You can also answer yes.

friendai.command.place.name.invalid: A place name must be 1-%s characters.
friendai.config.title: Friendai Settings
friendai.config.server_only: These settings are configured on the server.
friendai.config.server_protected: Server settings cannot be read, backed up or upgraded safely. friendai-server.json is kept read-only. Check the file, free disk space and folder permissions, then reopen this screen to retry.
friendai.config.server_unsupported: friendai-server.json has an unknown or newer format. Supported older formats upgrade automatically. Use a compatible mod version, or back up and replace the file to edit these settings.
friendai.config.api_key.tooltip: Use env:VAR_NAME to read the key from an environment variable.
friendai.config.companion.name: Name
friendai.config.companion.language.toolt: "auto" means the language the player writes in.
friendai.config.chat.guests_enabled: Let other players talk to companions
friendai.config.mining.catch_blocks: Most blocks spent on one drop
friendai.config.mining.valuable_blocks.d: Block ids and #tags whose drop must have somewhere to land before the block is broken, separated by commas.

friendai.voice.error.no_folder: No Yandex folder ID is set for speech recognition.
friendai.voice.error.unsupported_languag: This language is not supported by the selected speech provider.

friendai.voice.tts.sample: Hello! I can speak. This is how the selected voice sounds.
friendai.voice.tts.error.no_voice: No voice is selected or installed. Open the settings and download one.
friendai.voice.tts.error.no_key: No API key is set for speech.
friendai.voice.tts.error.auth: The API key was rejected. Check it in the settings.
friendai.voice.tts.error.quota: The speech quota is used up or exceeded. Try again later.
friendai.voice.tts.error.network: Could not reach the speech service. Check your connection.
friendai.voice.tts.error.playback: Could not play the speech. Check the output device.
friendai.voice.tts.error.model_corrupt: The voice file is corrupt. Download it again.
friendai.config.voice.provider.tooltip: Switching providers keeps each provider's own key and settings.
friendai.config.voice.field.key.tooltip: Stored in friendai-client.json. Use env:NAME to read it from an environment variable.
friendai.config.voice.field.key.copied: API key copied to the clipboard.
friendai.config.voice.field.folder_id.to: The Yandex Cloud folder that owns the API key.
friendai.config.voice.field.base_url.too: Leave blank for the provider default. Any server with an OpenAI-compatible speech API works, including a local one.
friendai.config.voice.field.language.too: Leave blank to follow the game language.
friendai.config.voice.tts.speak_guests: Speak replies addressed to other players
friendai.config.voice.tts.spatial.toolti: Play replies from the companion's position, with left and right panning and volume falling off with distance. Off plays every reply centred at full volume.
friendai.config.voice.tts.paid_notice: Paid: the provider bills per character. Friendai never retries automatically.
friendai.menu.title: Companion
friendai.menu.button_unavailable: Companion control (the server does not have Friendai)
friendai.menu.denied: You need operator permissions for that.
friendai.menu.settings.heading: Companion settings
friendai.menu.settings.hint: Each switch affects only this companion.
friendai.menu.settings.creative.title: Creative mode
friendai.menu.settings.creative.desc: Lets the companion place and take any block or item without gathering it. Needs an operator owner.
friendai.menu.settings.auto_respawn.desc: Brings the companion back at your bed or the world spawn after it dies, with everything it carried.
friendai.menu.settings.free_time.title: Free time
friendai.menu.settings.free_time.desc: When idle, the companion picks its own work: gathering, farming, building a base.
friendai.menu.settings.follow.title: Follow me
friendai.menu.settings.follow.desc: Walks after you whenever it has nothing else to do.
friendai.menu.settings.movement_debug.de: Draws the planned route and the work cells in the world. Operators only; off at every start.
friendai.menu.appearance.name: Name
friendai.menu.appearance.url_hint: https:// link to a skin PNG
friendai.menu.appearance.dialog_unavaila: No file dialog is available here. Use a username or a link instead.
friendai.skin.error.not_png: That file is not a PNG image.
friendai.skin.error.wrong_size: The skin must be exactly 64x64 pixels.
friendai.menu.rename.invalid: Invalid name: use 1-32 characters, without line breaks or formatting codes.
friendai.skin.error.rejected: The skin was rejected: it must be a valid 64x64 PNG.
friendai.skin.error.unknown_user: No Minecraft player with that name.
friendai.skin.error.network: Could not download the skin. Check your connection.
friendai.skin.error.host: That skin comes from a server that is not allowed.
friendai.skin.error.too_large: The skin file is too large.
friendai.skin.error.not_https: The link must start with https://.
friendai.skin.error.bad_name: A Minecraft name has 1-16 letters, digits or underscores.
friendai.skin.error.no_skin: That player has no custom skin.

friendai.menu.creative.connection: Connect to a Friendai server to change this setting
friendai.menu.creative.operator_required: Only an operator owner can enable creative mode
friendai.menu.chain.more: Only the first %s tasks are shown.
friendai.menu.description.title: Description
friendai.menu.description.invalid: Invalid personality. Use up to 300 characters without formatting codes.
friendai.menu.memory.error.too_long: The fact is too long (%s of %s characters).
friendai.menu.memory.error.duplicate: This is already remembered as fact %s.
friendai.menu.memory.error.bad_request: The request could not be understood.
friendai.menu.memory.error.unknown_playe: This player is not known or not online.
friendai.menu.memory.error.disabled: Memory is turned off on this server.

friendai.menu.places.error.name_invalid: A place name must be 1-%s characters.
friendai.mining.unsafe_support: I can't mine a block that supports me or the route.
friendai.mining.lava_below: I won't break %s: there is lava directly below it.
friendai.mining.server_protected: %s is protected by the server (spawn protection or a world rule).
friendai.mining.place_protected: %s is inside a place the owner asked me to protect.
friendai.mining.own_support_unsafe: The block under my feet at %s has an unsafe drop below.
friendai.mining.unsafe_passage: That passage is unsafe to excavate.
friendai.mining.no_tool: I don't have a suitable tool to collect this resource.
friendai.mining.inventory_full: My inventory has no room for the expected drop.
friendai.mining.search_limit: I reached the mining search limit.
friendai.mining.unreachable: I can't reach the resource safely.
friendai.mining.drop_unprotected: The drop of %s has nowhere safe to land, and I have no way to build a catch block there.
friendai.menu.traders.empty: No remembered traders or offers match this search.
friendai.menu.traders.forget_denied: This trader is pinned by an active order and cannot be forgotten yet.
friendai.menu.skills.invalid: Cannot apply this change. Check permissions, limits and the current version.
Cannot apply this change. Check permissions, limits and the current version.
friendai.menu.skills.name: Name
friendai.menu.skills.selection_hint: Kinds / triggers / tags (comma-separated; always and profile are optional kinds)
friendai.freetime.no_plan.empty_reply: The planner returned no answer. Try another planner model in settings.
friendai.freetime.no_plan.no_json: The planner answered with text instead of a plan. Try another planner model in settings.
friendai.freetime.no_plan.broken_json: The planner returned unreadable plan data. Try a simpler request or another planner model.
friendai.freetime.no_plan.truncated: The plan was cut off at the output limit. Ask for a shorter plan or raise the planner profile output limit.
friendai.freetime.no_plan.rejected: The plan was rejected (%s). Try a smaller goal or another planner model.
friendai.freetime.no_plan.too_large: The plan exceeds my queue limits. Ask for a smaller goal.
friendai.freetime.no_plan.unavailable: The planner could not be reached. Check its profile, connection and API key in settings.
friendai.config.agent.planner.tooltip: Profile used to draft plans. An empty choice uses the active profile. Choose a model that can return JSON.
friendai.config.agent.planner_retries.to: Total attempts per plan, including the first (1–4, default 2). Extra attempts may use paid tokens. Connection failures are not retried.
friendai.config.tasks.place_interval.too: Server ticks between two blocks placed in survival; a player places one every four. 1 is the fastest the printer can go, 40 the slowest (1–40, default 4). Creative mode always places one block per tick.
friendai.config.autonomy.tooltip: Passive never starts on its own, assistive nudges an idle companion toward an unfinished goal, autonomous may also ask what to do next. It never acts unprompted.
friendai.config.agent.max_replans.toolti: How many times a failed plan may be rebuilt before the companion asks for help (0–10, default 3).
friendai.config.agent.goal_tick_sec.tool: How often an idle companion is nudged toward an unfinished goal (10–600 seconds, default 30).
friendai.config.agent.prompt_budget.tool: Maximum characters of the system prompt; 0 means unlimited. Larger prompts cost more tokens.
friendai.config.agent.planner_timeout_se: How long one planner call may take (10–300 seconds, default 60).
friendai.config.tasks.mine_search_radius: Blocks searched around the companion when looking for a block to mine (1–128, default 32).
friendai.config.tasks.tree_search_radius: How far the companion looks for a tree to fell (1–128, default 32).
friendai.config.tasks.timeout_sec.toolti: How long one task may run before it is stopped and reported (10–3600 seconds, default 300).
friendai.config.tasks.queue_max_jobs.too: Maximum queued jobs (1–256, default 64). Older low-priority work is refused when full.
friendai.config.tasks.queue_max_plans.to: Maximum queued plans (1–32, default 8). Each plan holds several steps.
friendai.config.tasks.queue_max_steps.to: Maximum steps accepted in one plan (1–128, default 32).
friendai.config.pathing.search_budget_ms: Time one path search may spend per tick (1–50 ms, default 2). Higher values find paths sooner but can cost frame time.
friendai.config.pathing.max_gather.toolt: How many blocks the companion may gather while routing (1–256, default 64).
friendai.config.places.max.tooltip: Maximum places kept per owner (1–512, default 128).
friendai.config.structures.max_nearby.to: How many mobs of a structure’s kind may already stand near the site before another is built (0–32, default 4).
friendai.config.autonomy.enabled: Let the companion work while you are away
friendai.config.autonomy.idle_minutes.to: How long you must be idle before free time starts (1–240 minutes, default 5).
friendai.config.autonomy.shift_minutes.t: How long one free-time shift lasts (1–240 minutes, default 20).
friendai.config.autonomy.max_shifts.tool: Maximum free-time shifts per hour (0–60, default 6).
friendai.config.autonomy.fail_cooldown.t: Minutes before another shift after a failure (0–240, default 10).
friendai.config.trading.radius.tooltip: How far the companion looks for villagers and their trades (8–64 blocks, default 64).
friendai.config.trading.quote_fresh_seco: How long a quoted price stays usable before the companion asks again (1–3600 seconds, default 60).
friendai.config.trading.location_fresh_m: How long a remembered villager position stays fresh (1–60 minutes, default 10).
friendai.config.trading.idle_refresh_sec: How often idle trade offers refresh (1–600 seconds, default 10).
friendai.config.trading.wait_seconds.too: How long the companion waits at a villager for a trade to appear (1–600 seconds, default 120).
friendai.config.trading.max_wait_seconds: Upper bound for one wait, used when the companion decides to wait longer (1–600 seconds, default 600).
friendai.config.trading.max_ingots.toolt: Most gold ingots the companion may offer a piglin in one barter (1–64, default 64).
friendai.config.trading.default_ingots.t: Gold ingots offered when the owner does not say how many (1–64, default 8).
friendai.config.resources.local_radius.t: How far the companion looks for resources without an expedition (16–128 blocks, default 64).
How long one local resource search may run (10–600 seconds, default 120).
friendai.config.resources.expedition_rad: How far the companion may travel for a resource it cannot find nearby (16–2048 blocks, default 512).
friendai.config.resources.expedition_min: How long one expedition may run before it returns (1–40 minutes, default 10).
friendai.config.resources.observation_ra: How far the companion notices a resource while searching (4–64 blocks, default 64).
friendai.config.resources.wait_for_owner: Wait for the owner before leaving
friendai.config.resources.owner_sight.to: How close the owner must be for an escort to count as together (8–128 blocks, default 32).
friendai.config.resources.owner_hold.too: How far the companion may drift before it stops to wait for the owner (9–512 blocks, default 48). Must stay above the sight radius.
friendai.config.resources.owner_resume.t: How close the owner must come before a waiting companion resumes (1–511 blocks, default 24). Must stay below the hold distance.
friendai.config.companion.chunk_loading: Keep chunks loaded around the companion
friendai.config.companion.chunk_radius.t: How many chunks around the companion keep ticking (0–4, default 1). 0 keeps only the companion's own chunk. Higher values cost server performance.
friendai.config.chat.hearing_radius.tool: How far a player's chat reaches the companion (4–64 blocks, default 64).
friendai.config.chat.max_reply_chars.too: Maximum characters in one chat reply; longer answers are cut (32–256, default 256).
friendai.config.chat.guest_cooldown_seco: How long a guest must wait between messages to the companion (0–60 seconds, default 5).
friendai.config.brain.max_tool_steps.too: How many tool calls the companion may make before it must answer (1–32, default 8). Higher values allow longer tasks but cost more tokens.
friendai.config.brain.history_messages.t: How many recent messages are sent with each request (6–200, default 30). More history means better continuity and a larger, costlier request.
friendai.config.brain.request_timeout_se: How long one model request may take before it is abandoned (5–600 seconds, default 60).
friendai.config.brain.cooldown_ms.toolti: Minimum pause between two replies to the same player (0–60000 milliseconds, default 500).
friendai.config.memory.transcript_entrie: How many recent chat lines are stored per owner to remember a conversation (20–2000, default 200).
Maximum characters kept from one chat line (100–2000, default 400).
friendai.config.memory.transcript_retent: How long stored chat lines are kept before they are deleted (1–90 days, default 7).
friendai.config.memory.compact_at_percen: How full the memory book must be before the model is told it is nearly full (50–100%, default 90).
friendai.config.autonomy.while_offline: Keep working while you are offline
friendai.config.autonomy.resume_after.to: How long you must be back before a paused free-time shift resumes (10–900 seconds, default 60).
friendai.config.autonomy.offline_shifts: Shifts per hour while you are away
Maximum free-time shifts per hour while you are offline (0–60, default 2).
friendai.config.tasks.tree_perception_ra: How far the companion notices trees while working (4–24 blocks, default 12).
friendai.config.tasks.queue_blocked_noti: How often the owner is told a queued job is still blocked (5–600 seconds, default 30).
friendai.config.tasks.free_time_watchdog: How long free time may make no progress before it is stopped (1–600 seconds, default 120).
friendai.config.places.auto_mine_min_blo: How many blocks must be dug in one spot before it is remembered as a mine (1–256, default 16).
friendai.config.places.merge_radius.tool: Places closer than this are treated as one (1–64 blocks, default 16).
friendai.config.places.prompt_limit.tool: How many remembered places are described in a chat prompt (1–12, default 6).
friendai.config.places.prompt_budget.too: How many characters the remembered places may take in a prompt (200–4000, default 1200).
friendai.config.places.planner_limit.too: How many remembered places the planner may consider (1–128, default 40).
friendai.config.pathing.max_nodes.toolti: How many positions one path search may examine (1000–100000, default 20000). Higher values find longer routes and cost more server time.
friendai.config.skills.per_outcome.toolt: How many instruction skills one finished job may teach (0–2, default 2).
friendai.config.skills.owner_count.toolt: How many instruction skills are kept per owner (1–64, default 64).
friendai.config.skills.server_count.tool: How many shared instruction skills are kept per server (1–32, default 32).
friendai.config.skills.total_chars.toolt: Upper bound on stored instruction-skill text per owner (4000–96000, default 96000).
friendai.config.memory.max_facts_per_pla: How many facts are remembered about each player (1–128, default 128).
friendai.config.memory.max_world_facts.t: How many facts are remembered about the world (1–200, default 128).
friendai.config.skills.budget.tooltip: Characters of instruction skills allowed in one prompt (200–6000, default 4096). More room means more skills and a larger, costlier request.
friendai.config.skills.hourly.tooltip: How many instruction skills the model may write per hour (0–60, default 6).
friendai.config.mining.catch_blocks.tool: Most blocks one protected drop may cost as a platform or shortcut (0–27, default 9).
friendai.config.pathing.allow_break.tool: Whether the companion may dig through blocks on its way to a destination. Turn it off to keep builds intact.
friendai.config.pathing.allow_place.tool: Whether the companion may place blocks to climb or bridge on its way. Turn it off to keep builds intact.
friendai.config.chat.listen_all.tooltip: Whether the companion reacts to chat it was not addressed in. Off by default so it does not interrupt.
friendai.config.chat.guests_enabled.tool: Whether players the owner has not trusted may talk to the companion.
Whether free time may place blocks. Off keeps autonomous work to gathering, travel and crafting.
friendai.config.mining.protect_drops.too: Whether a valuable drop is protected with a platform before its block is broken, spending blocks to avoid losing it.
